items.title: Take-Two Stock Rises 4.2% as GTA VI Outlook Holds
items.summary: Take-Two maintained its $8 billion-plus bookings forecast ahead of the scheduled November launch of Grand Theft Auto VI.

items.title: Take-Two Shares Slip as Conservative Outlook Overshadows Strong First-Quarter Results
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software (NASDAQ:TTWO) reported better-than-expected first-quarter results, but shares moved lower after the video game publisher issued guidance that fell short of Wall Street forecasts despite reaffirming its full-year outlook ahead of the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. The stock slipped around 2% as investors focused on the company’s cautious projections for the coming quarters.

items.title: Take-Two Sticks To Its Guns On Full-Year Outlook. TTWO Stock Rises On 'GTA 6' Preorders.
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software beat estimates for its fiscal first quarter but stayed with its prior full-year outlook. TTWO stock rose.

items.title: Take-Two Q1 earnings beat expectations ahead of GTA VI launch
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc (NASDAQ:TTWO) reported first-quarter revenue of $1.53 billion, topping analyst estimates of $1.41 billion, as the video game publisher prepares for the November 19 launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI." Net bookings for the quarter came in at $1.39 billion, down 3%...
